Warm-up: say one word you already know for this topic.

Which word belongs to this topic?
Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

street — a road with houses or shops. Example: The streets are clean.
near — close to. Example: It is near the park.
far — not near. Example: It is not far.
building — a structure with walls and a roof. Example: The building is old.
place — an area or location. Example: My favourite place is the square.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Where is the ...?
• Go along this street.
• Turn left at the ...
• It is near the ...
• Is it far?
Vocabulary practice: choose the correct word.

Complete the sentence with a word from the list.
Questions rise at the end.
Where is the museum? ↗
Listen and repeat three times.
Which word carries the main stress?
Grammar focus: There is / There are for places in town.
Ask Where is the ...? and answer with imperatives and landmarks: Go along this street and turn left at the bank. It is near the museum.
Controlled practice: choose the correct option.
Choose the correct direction.
Choose the correct question.
Complete the sentence.
Reading: read the text and answer the questions.
I ask where the museum is. A woman says: go along this street and turn right at the big building. The museum is near the park, not far.
Listening: listen to the dialogue and answer the questions.
A: Excuse me, where is the hospital? B: Go along this street and turn left at the bank. It is near the park. A: Is it far? B: No, ten minutes.
Speaking: pair work
